summary: Grande Group Ltd/HK filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into an Ordinary Share Purchase Agreement with White Lion Capital, LLC for up to $40M in newly issued Class A ordinary shares over 36 months. Pricing is based on a formula referencing lowest traded prices or 97% of VWAP. A concurrent Registration Rights Agreement was executed. This is a structured equity facility (common in finance), not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or definitive close date. There is no transformative event; the filing is an ordinary shelf-like arrangement.
